messages:
Noor Ali: Hi everyone 44b First day on Runtime (remote, UK). Quick things: 1) Mac M2 vs Linux devbox? 2) VPN + MFA setup for EU remote? 3) how do I request infra/project access and SSH keys? 4) I'll be in SF in 3 weeks 3d6 who handles badge pickup? Also small thing: I play ukulele and make terrible puns 3b8

Rashmi (IT): Welcome Noor! For Runtime we typically ship Macs (M2) but Linux devboxes are fine if you prefer full-Linux toolchain. DM your shipping address and I'll start the order. For Mac MDM enrollment run:

```
open /Applications/RedwoodMDM/Enroll.app
# if blocked: sudo installer -pkg /tmp/RedwoodMDM.pkg -target /
```

For VPN in EU we use WireGuard + Okta MFA. I'll DM a preconfigured wg0.conf. For SSH: generate ed25519 key and paste public key at https://redwood.github.io/ssh-keys, then request access to the project via the internal access UI.

Gabe (People Ops): Hey Noor 60a Badge pickup: fill https://redwood.intranet/forms/badge and choose "SF HQ pickup" for your date. Bring photo ID. Also we've got a welcome lunch the week you arrive if dates line up. Sent onboarding emails to your personal address  check spam and let me know if missing.

Elliot Ramos: Hi Noor 44b I'm your buddy for week one. I can pair tomorrow at 4pm UK time to get you into the repos and the local runtime dev flow. Quick SSH steps I usually send new hires:

1) `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "noor@redwood.com"`
2) `cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` and paste to the keys UI
3) request access to `redwood/runtime` and `redwood/common-infra`

Also tiny team rituals: daily standup at 9:30am PT (late afternoon for you) and a biweekly demo + snacks (virtual snack cards for remote folks).

Noor Ali: Awesome, thanks! I'll DM address and my public key now. 4pm UK pairing works. Also note: mild peanut allergy and I live on tea not coffee 37537a

Rashmi (IT): Added you to the provisioning queue and will ship the Mac unless you change your mind. If you pick Linux, tell me preferred distro.

BuddyBot: Noor Ali was added to #eng-runtime and #new-hires. :tada:

Gabe (People Ops): Sent the welcome lunch RSVP and virtual snack card. Welcome aboard 389
